passives.description:
On $Attack:
- Also performs $UlquiorraEVO_Skill3 for {1}% of this unit’s damage, targeting the enemy in Last (Cooldown: {2}s)

- Inflict $Oppression for {3} seconds
- Enemies afflicted with $Oppression take {4}% more damage
